name: Member
definition: A person on the student club roster, identified by member_id and described by name, contact details, club position, t-shirt size and residence zip code.
scope: Club roster, engagement and financial attribution analysis. 33 records in the database.

name: Event
definition: A club activity with a name, scheduled date-time, type, location, free-text notes and lifecycle status.
scope: Club activity analysis. 42 records spanning 2019-09-01 to 2020-05-05.

name: Major
definition: An academic programme of study, described by major_name and its owning department and college.
scope: Academic-composition analysis of the roster. 113 records covering 47 departments and 8 colleges.

name: Zip Code
definition: A postal-code reference record resolving a numeric zip code to a city, county, state and short state designation.
scope: Geographic analysis of member residence. National reference table of 41877 records; only the zips referenced by member.zip are relevant to the club.

name: Budget Line
definition: An allocation of funds for a spending category within one event, carrying the budgeted amount, the amount spent, the amount remaining, and the event's status as recorded at budget time.
scope: Event-level financial planning. 52 records covering 23 distinct events; an event may hold more than one budget line.

name: Expense
definition: A single recorded club expenditure with a description, date, cost, approval flag, the member who submitted it and the budget line it is charged against.
scope: Actual spending analysis. 32 records, all dated within 2019.

name: Income
definition: A single recorded inflow of funds with a receipt date, integer amount, source label, optional notes and an optional link to the member associated with the receipt.
scope: Funding analysis. 36 records, all dated within 2019.

name: Attendance
definition: An association record asserting that a specific member attended a specific event. The pair of event and member is the identity of the record.
scope: Engagement analysis. 326 records pairing 30 distinct members with 17 distinct events.

name: Member Position
definition: The role a member holds in the club, ranging from ordinary membership through elected officer titles to the non-participating value Inactive.
scope: Roster segmentation and officer identification.

name: Event Type
definition: The category of club activity an event represents, such as Meeting, Guest Speaker, Game, Social, Community Service, Election, Budget or Registration.
scope: Event portfolio analysis.

name: Event Status
definition: The lifecycle state of an event — Closed, Open or Planning — describing whether the activity has concluded, is active, or is still being arranged. The same state is recorded on both the event and its budget lines.
scope: Event lifecycle and budget-stage analysis.

name: Budget Category
definition: The spending category a budget line funds, such as Food, Advertisement, Speaker Gifts, Parking or Club T-Shirts.
scope: Allocation analysis by spending purpose.

name: Income Source
definition: The origin of a receipt: Dues collected from members, or non-member sources such as Sponsorship, School Appropriation and Fundraising.
scope: Funding-mix analysis.

name: Expense Approval Status
definition: Whether an expense has been approved, encoded as a text flag rather than a boolean or numeric value.
scope: Spending-control analysis and filtering of approved versus unapproved costs.

name: College
definition: The academic college that owns a major, used to aggregate members by their broader academic home.
scope: Academic-composition analysis. 8 distinct colleges.

name: Member State
definition: The state of a member's residence, reached by resolving the member's zip code through the postal reference table.
scope: Geographic distribution of the roster.

name: Event Date
definition: The scheduled date and time of an event.
scope: Temporal ordering and period filtering of events. Club event data spans 2019-09-01 to 2020-05-05.

name: Active Member
definition: A member who is currently participating in the club, as opposed to a member whose position is recorded as Inactive.
scope: Roster size and participation denominators.

name: Dues Income
definition: The subset of income received as member dues, as distinct from sponsorship, appropriation or fundraising receipts.
scope: Recurring member-derived funding analysis.

name: Member Count
definition: The number of member records in the roster.
scope: Roster sizing and denominators for per-member analysis.

name: Event Count
definition: The number of event records.
scope: Activity volume measurement.

name: Attendance Count
definition: The number of member-event attendance records, i.e. the total number of member appearances across events.
scope: Engagement volume measurement at event grain, member grain or club grain.

name: Income Amount
definition: The monetary value of a single income receipt, recorded in whole currency units.
scope: Summed over all receipts or grouped by source, member or period.

name: Expense Cost
definition: The monetary cost of a single recorded expenditure, recorded with fractional currency precision.
scope: Summed over all expenses or grouped by member, budget line or period.

name: Budget Amount
definition: The funds allocated to a budget line for its category within its event, recorded in whole currency units.
scope: Allocation totals grouped by category, event or period.

name: Budget Spent Amount
definition: The portion of a budget line's allocation that has been consumed, recorded with fractional currency precision.
scope: Utilisation analysis per budget line or grouped by category and event.

name: Budget Remaining Amount
definition: The unspent portion of a budget line's allocation, which becomes negative when the line is overspent.
scope: Budget headroom and overspend detection.

name: Net Financial Balance
definition: Total recorded income minus total recorded expense over the covered period.
scope: Club-level financial position for the period where both income and expense records exist.

name: Budget Utilization Rate
definition: The proportion of a budget line's allocation that has been spent, formed as spent amount relative to allocated amount.
scope: Comparison of spending intensity across categories and events; not defined for lines with zero allocation.
